claims: New Zealand defeated South Africa by eight wickets in the third T20I on March 20, 2026, in Auckland.
New Zealand took a 2-1 lead in their five-match series against South Africa.
New Zealand chased the target in 16.2 overs.
New Zealand won the third T20I by 8 wickets.
New Zealand leads 2-1 in the series.
Lockie Ferguson took 1/9 in 4 overs for New Zealand.
Mitchell Santner took 2/21 for New Zealand.
Kyle Jamieson took 2/42 for New Zealand.
Ben Sears took 2/27 for New Zealand.
Nqobani Mokoena scored 26* for South Africa.
George Linde scored 23 for South Africa.
South Africa was put in to bat.
